$Comment: Elsie the Weaver, one of the three villagers standing in the Forgotten Temple while Harvest Feast
runs, so a player carrying the invitation tour always has somebody to ask, and one of Santa's three
helpers while Christmas runs. The roles, this placement and the conversations pressing F opens all
ship in this pack. Author Dialogue or Open, never both.
Seasons is what makes Elsie a guest, and one woman in two seasons: the placement stands while any
listed calendar event is switched on and running, and the entry in effect is the first, in list
order, whose event runs. The Harvest_Feast entry comes first and changes nothing, so while the feast
runs (its last days overlap the start of Christmas) she stands at her feast spot in her feast clothes
with her feast conversation, which gains a Christmas line from the first day of Christmas
(DialogueExtensions/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Weaver_Feast_Line.json). Once only Christmas runs, its
entry replaces four leaves whole: Role, her winter clothes (NPC/Roles/Passive/Christmas_Weaver.json),
the library changing the standing NPC's role in place; Interact, her Christmas conversation
(Dialogues/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Weaver.json); Anchor, her Christmas spot; and Props, her stall. A
new Anchor takes her away from her feast spot and stands her at the new one. The library looks at every placement
again at each start and end and whenever she is loaded, so nothing needs a restart. Lifecycle keeps
her chunk loaded, stands her up again if something removes her, and raises her health past anything
that can be dealt.
Where finds the temple by its GameplayConfig id, which stays the same on every visit while the
world's name does not. Identity.NpcId is spelled as her feast role and never changes with an entry's
Role, so a nameplate key built from it resolves and every quest, talk step and hand-in bound to
Harvest_Feast_Weaver finds her in both seasons. Each villager has an id and a conversation of their
own: the invitation line is spent per conversation, so two villagers sharing one would count as one
person asked.
At the feast the three villagers stand apart, so asking them all is a walk through the temple: Bram
on the meadow halfway down the road from the arrival, Tomas where that road comes into the kweebec
village, and Elsie on the village's far side. The file's Anchor stands Elsie beside the Rootling
Merchant's spawn marker (Temple_Kweebec_Merchant_Static), which every Forgotten Temple carries once,
so she moves with the temple's own layout: sixteen blocks along negative X and five along positive Z
from the marker is the cobbled ground just south of the marble dais on the village's west side, well
clear of the merchant. Limits.OncePerWorld keeps her to one spot even if a temple ever carries the
marker twice. At Christmas she keeps a stall beside Santa on the marble floor on the round hall's
north side: the Christmas entry's Anchor is the temple's arrival spot plus an offset, ten blocks along
negative X and eight along negative Z, four blocks east of Santa (X -14), facing the path (Yaw 180).
Her Props there are a tavern table in front of her and two of the game's Christmas Packets beside it,
offset along the world's own axes and raised half a block (Y 0.5), because a block is drawn centred
on the point it is given. To move Elsie, edit the Offset and Yaw of the Anchor for the season you
mean, then look at the spot in game. To take her out without editing this file, set enabled (lower
case, as that file spells it) to false for this id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/npc-placements.json.
Name: Harvest_Feast_Weaver_Temple
